title: Russia Claims Capture of Two Villages in Eastern Ukraine as Frontline Battles Continue
detail: Russia's Ministry of Defense claimed the capture of two villages in eastern Ukraine, while Kyiv's military reported active frontline battles across multiple sectors. The Russian advances, if confirmed, would represent incremental territorial gains in the ongoing eastern front pressure campaign. Ukrainian forces reported repelling multiple assaults as fighting continued along the Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia axes.

media.caption: Russian forces claim territorial gains in eastern Ukraine as frontline fighting intensifies
